description: This file contains CRUD operations for managing input variables related to test files and test cases, including functions to get, create, and delete variables in a database.

methods.name: get_variables_by_test_file
methods.description: Retrieves all file-level input variables for a specific test file ID where testcase_id is NULL.

methods.name: get_variables_by_testcase
methods.description: Retrieves all input variables for a specific test file and test case ID, with additional logging if no variables are found for the specific test file.

methods.name: create_variables_bulk
methods.description: Creates multiple input variables in bulk for a given test file and optional test case ID, then commits and refreshes the created objects.

methods.name: delete_variables_by_test_file
methods.description: Deletes all input variables associated with a specific test file ID.
